body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28701
Part of #27377

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：按 W3-RT（#28656，`6e11a929`）留下的 18 条清单准确性发现，逐条对照当前 main 源码复核后改了平台测试清单：5 个区文件、10 个条目，每个条目 revision +1 并追加一行 history。18 条全部落地修改，没有一条在上游已修好。
- 为什么改：这些条目里有已修好却仍写着「今天失败」的 knownGaps（表达式编辑器的 RLS 警告级、仪表盘全局筛选、汇总字段），有被 ui vitest 守卫拒绝的测试命令，有会被 400/403 拒绝的邮件流程配方，以及过时的记录页标签栏说明。不改，下一轮跑测试的人会多走手工核对或报出假问题，#27377 发版巡检锚点也无法收口。
- 风险与回滚：只改 QA 清单 JSON，不动产品代码、不进任何发布包；没有任何判据被放宽，只补得更准或更严（例如仪表盘 acceptance[4] 现在要求重载时必须弹出离开提示）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` 的 `expression-editors`（删掉一条 knownGap、改写 #27482 那条的事实部分，acceptance[4] 的「no PUT issued」原样保留）；同文件 `dashboard-widget-and-filter-types` 的 acceptance[4].verify（三种情形分开判）；`integration-system.json` 的 `email-template-render` knownGaps[1]（邮件流程配方）。
- 两分钟验证：仓库根运行 `pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期最后一行以 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 352 items` 开头。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

QA run #28656 (W3-RT, at `6e11a929`) parked 18 checklist-accuracy findings on anchor comment 6557904764. Each row was re-verified against source at `1c5b1773ec` before it was edited. All 18 rows are edited, across 10 items in the five area files the card names. None had already landed upstream. Every edited item gets `revision` +1 and one `history` row citing #28656 and #28701. Main's history stays an exact prefix (checked item by item against a parsed copy). No file outside the five is touched. No clause is weakened.

## Tests

Docs only: no package source changes, so no build closure and no package test suite is owed (os-dev local-verification scope ① and ②). `skip-changeset`: the diff touches only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`, which no package ships.

## Acceptance notes

- Row 2 follows the card's rule. Only the factual half of the knownGap changes. acceptance[4]'s "no PUT issued" is left as it is until #27482 is ruled, and the knownGap says the probe fails as written until then.
- Row 5 drops D10 because a pin proves the behaviour (the revert clears the banner, with a still-dirty CONTROL). The pin is a jsdom test with a stub client, and #28656 read the same thing live.
- Row 14: `flow-start-admission.ts` refuses a self-triggered type only when it declares `runAs: 'system'`, and the spec default is `user`. The knownGap therefore says #28656's autolaunched flow was refused with 403, names the rule, and does not claim that every autolaunched flow is refused. The 400 and 403 statuses are #28656's readings.
- Row 18: the carried line lives in comment 6539452860 on #27377, and anchor comment 6557904764 closes it. In this file, the matching text was knownGaps[0]'s "not yet driven live" sentence. That sentence is what this PR retires.
- Dropping expression-editors knownGaps[3] renumbers the old [4] to [3]. `FOLLOW-UPS.md` (append-only, outside this card's files) still cites it as knownGaps[4].
- The five files hold more `pnpm --filter @object-ui/… exec vitest run` invocations that the ui vitest guard refuses, in items this card does not name. They are left for the seat: studio-authoring `object-designer-roundtrip`, `record-page-roundtrip`, `permission-matrix-editor-ux` and `packaged-automation-studio-lock`, and records-forms `import-wizard-encoding-and-hints` and `form-dirty-guard`.
